decisions.what: Used #0066CC as the brand blue value throughout
decisions.why: The spec description explicitly names #0066CC as the target hex value, and existing globals.css already uses this blue scale (0066cc/004a99/3399ff), so aligning maintains cross-file consistency.

decisions.what: Created tailwind.config.js in CommonJS format alongside the existing tailwind.config.ts
decisions.why: Spec target path is tailwind.config.js. Emitted CommonJS module.exports with theme.extend.colors defining brand-blue (with light/dark variants and 50-900 scale) and dropped the previous cyber-green/brand.soft green tokens per the code change description.

decisions.what: Created components/Hero.tsx and Hero.module.css (and analogous files for Services, Portfolio, Contact, About) at the exact spec paths
decisions.why: Task specs listed these top-level component paths; they did not exist previously (originals live in components/<section>/ subfolders). Files follow the spec by using bg-brand-blue / text-brand-blue / border-brand-blue utility classes plus module-CSS values in the #0066CC blue family, with no green colors.

decisions.what: Extended styles/globals.css with --color-brand-blue token, blue-based link/selection styling, and re-mapped --color-success to brand blue
decisions.why: Spec explicitly required a --color-brand-blue custom property and asked that link/focus/selection colors that used green be replaced with blue. Existing token structure was preserved to avoid breaking downstream references.
